from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
ns={'s':'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'}
for name in ('logo.svg','mark.svg'):
 p=Path(name); r=ET.parse(p).getroot()
 assert r.attrib['viewBox']
 assert r.find('s:title',ns) is not None
 assert not r.findall('.//s:text',ns)
 assert not r.findall('.//s:image',ns)
 assert not r.findall('.//s:script',ns)
 for node in r.iter():
  assert not any('href' in key for key in node.attrib)
 print(f'{name}: valid SVG, {len(r.findall(\".//s:path\",ns))} paths, {p.stat().st_size:,} bytes')
